7787-a-complete-grammar-of-esperanto.title: Together With Full Vocabularies
7787-a-complete-grammar-of-esperanto.creator: IVY KELLERMAN, A.M., Ph.D.
7787-a-complete-grammar-of-esperanto.description: A book by IVY KELLERMAN, A.M., Ph.D.. n prepared to meet a twofold need. An adequate presentation of the International Language has become an imperative necessity. Such presentation, including full and accurate grammatical explanations, suitably graded reading lessons, and similarly graded material for translation from English, has not heretofore been accessible within the compass of a single volume, or in fact within the compass of any two or three volumes.

arxiv-1906-01950.title: VoIDext: Vocabulary and Patterns for Enhancing Interoperable Datasets with Virtual Links
arxiv-1906-01950.creator: Tarcisio M. de Farias(✉), Kurt Stockinger, Christophe Dessimoz
arxiv-1906-01950.description: Abstract Semantic heterogeneity remains a problem when interoperating with data from sources of different scopes and knowledge domains. Causes for this challenge are context-specific requirements (i.e. no “one model fits all”), different data modelling decisions, domain-specific purposes, and technical constraints.

arxiv-2106-03243.title: Neural Active Learning with Performance Guarantees
arxiv-2106-03243.creator: Pranjal Awasthi, Christoph Dann, Claudio Gentile, Ayush Sekhari, Zhilei Wang
arxiv-2106-03243.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pranjal Awasthi, Christoph Dann, Claudio Gentile, Ayush Sekhari, Zhilei Wang. We investigate the problem of active learning in the streaming setting in non-parametric regimes, where the labels are stochastically generated from a class of functions on which we make no assumptions whatsoever. We rely on recently proposed Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) approximation tools to construct a suitable neural embedding that determines the feature space the algorithm operates on and the learned model computed atop.

arxiv-2306-01629.title: Number of attractors in the critical Kauffman model is exponential
arxiv-2306-01629.creator: T. M. A. Fink and F. C. Sheldon
arxiv-2306-01629.description: Abstract The Kauffman model is the archetypal model of genetic computation. It highlights the importance of criticality, at which many biological systems seem poised. In a series of advances, researchers have honed in on how the number of attractors in the critical regime grows with network size. But a definitive answer has proved elusive.

arxiv-2401-13734.title: Dynamical Generation of the Baryon Asymmetry from a Scale Hierarchy
arxiv-2401-13734.creator: Jae Hyeok Chang, Kwang Sik Jeong, Chang Hyeon Lee, Chang Sub Shin
arxiv-2401-13734.description: Abstract We propose a novel baryogenesis scenario where the baryon asymmetry originates directly from a hierarchy between two fundamental mass scales: the electroweak scale v v and the Planck scale M P M_{P} , in the form of Y B ∼ v M P . Y_{B}\sim\sqrt{\frac{v}{M_{P}}}\,.

arxiv-2406-02461.title: RoomTex: Texturing Compositional Indoor Scenes via Iterative Inpainting
arxiv-2406-02461.creator: Qi Wang, Ruijie Lu, Xudong Xu, Jingbo Wang, Michael Yu Wang, Bo Dai, Gang Zeng, Dan Xu
arxiv-2406-02461.description: Abstract The advancement of diffusion models has pushed the boundary of text-to-3D object generation. While it is straightforward to composite objects into a scene with reasonable geometry, it is nontrivial to texture such a scene perfectly due to style inconsistency and occlusions between objects.

arxiv-2411-09846.title: Leveraging Propagated Infection to Crossfire Mutants
arxiv-2411-09846.creator: Hang Du, Vijay Krishna Palepu, James A. Jones
arxiv-2411-09846.description: Abstract Mutation testing was proposed to identify weaknesses in test suites by repeatedly generating artificially faulty versions of the software ( i.e., mutants ) and determining if the test suite is sufficient to detect them ( i.e., kill them). When the tests are insufficient, each surviving mutant provides an opportunity to improve the test suite.

arxiv-2509-02867.title: Versatile, open-source program for simulating high-harmonic generation Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2509-02867.creator: Christian A. Schröder 1,2,3,*, Reinhard Kienberger 3 and Stephen R. Leone 1,2
arxiv-2509-02867.description: Abstract Light sources based on high-harmonic generation (HHG) underpin ultrafast spectroscopy experiments across a large range of photon energies, spanning from the extreme-ultraviolet to the soft x-ray. To this day their design, implementation and improvement presents uniqe challenges, but can be aided by numerical tools.

arxiv-2510-12165.title: Lectures on stochastic sewing with applications
arxiv-2510-12165.creator: Oleg Butkovsky
arxiv-2510-12165.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Oleg Butkovsky. These are lecture notes for a mini-course on stochastic sewing, taught at the University of Edinburgh and Beijing Institute of Technology in Spring/Summer 2025. The aim is to introduce the reader to stochastic sewing techniques and to show how they can be successfully applied to study various problems in stochastic analysis, including: regularization by noise for stochastic differential equations driven by Brownian motion or fractional Brownian motion, well-posedness of stochastic PDEs with irregular drift, the study of averaging operators and local times,

arxiv-2511-19345.title: Optimizing Weak Orders via Integer Linear Programming
arxiv-2511-19345.creator: Juan A. Aledo, Concepción Domínguez, Juan de Dios Jaime-Alcántara, Mercedes Landete
arxiv-2511-19345.description: Abstract Rank aggregation problems aim to combine multiple individual orderings of a common set of items into a consensus ranking that best reflects the collective preferences. This paper introduces a general Integer Linear Programming (ILP) framework to model and solve, in an exact way, problems whose solutions are weak orders (a.k.a. bucket orders).

pmc-10709148.title: A mechanosensitive caveolae–invadosome interplay drives matrix remodelling for cancer cell invasion
pmc-10709148.creator: Pedro Monteiro, David Remy, Eline Lemerle, Fiona Routet, Anne-Sophie Macé, Chloé Guedj, Benoit Ladoux, Stéphane Vassilopoulos, Christophe Lamaze, Philippe Chavrier
pmc-10709148.description: Invadosomes and caveolae are mechanosensitive structures that are implicated in metastasis. Here, we describe a unique juxtaposition of caveola clusters and matrix degradative invadosomes at contact sites between the plasma membrane of cancer cells and constricting fibrils both in 2D and 3D type I collagen matrix environments.

pmc-10738243.title: QUALITY OF DAILY ACTIVITIES AND LONELINESS IN A ROMANTIC RELATIONSHIP
pmc-10738243.creator: Jana Nikitin, Fabio Selovin, Fiona Rupprecht
pmc-10738243.description: Romantic relationships can be a source of both the most positive and the most negative experiences. Thus, partners can feel fully integrated or lonely in a romantic relationship, depending on the quality of the relationship. Cross-sectional and longitudinal studies have shown that loneliness (defined as a subjectively perceived deficiency in a person’s social relationship) is more pronounced in low-quality relationships.

pmc-11442228.title: Combinatorial protection of cochlear hair cells: not too little but not too much
pmc-11442228.creator: Arwa Kurabi, Kwang Pak, Eun Jung Lee, Allen F. Ryan
pmc-11442228.description: BackgroundA number of drugs are toxic to the cochlear sensory cells known as hair cells (HCs), resulting in hearing loss. Treatment with survival-promoting growth factors, antioxidants, and inhibitors of cell death pathways or proteinases have been shown to reduce HC damage in in vivo and/or in vitro animal models. Conversely, translation to humans has often been disappointing.

pmc-11605627.title: 10148- ACT-7 BORON NEUTRON CAPTURE THERAPY FROM TWO-DIRECTION FOR HIGH-GRADE MENINGIOMAS ACHIEVED BY PATIENT REPOSITIONING AND CONTINUOUS BPA ADMINISTRATION

uslaw-usc-t8-s1458.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t8-s1458.description: United States Code, Title 8 (Aliens And Nationality); Chapter 12 (Immigration And Nationality); Subchapter III (Nationality And Naturalization); Part II (Nationality Through Naturalization). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Attorney General is authorized and directed to prepare from the records in the custody of the Service a report upon those heretofore seeking citizenship to show by nationalities their relation to the numbers.
